messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Staged commit & billing timeline for Finnovate MAP

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for taking the demo last week. Per our conversation, I put together a concise staged mutual action plan (MAP) so we can align milestones to commercial checkpoints and the invoicing cadence. High level:

1) Evaluation phase (2–4 weeks): sandbox access + engineering support. No charges until evaluation completes unless you request early pilot billing.
2) Pilot ramp (30 days): production-like throughput for a capped token commitment; 15% pilot discount if you commit to the pilot capacity.
3) Full ramp (starts on agreed go-live or when PO is issued, see options below): pricing tiers kick in based on committed monthly tokens/throughput.

Two operational asks from procurement I want to confirm before we finalize the MAP: 1) PO required before we start invoicing? 2) Do you need Net60 vs our standard Net30? Both affect the billing start date and any early discount approval.

Attached is a first-pass MAP spreadsheet that ties each MAP milestone to pricing checkpoints and suggested invoice triggers. Key points:
- Standard billing start = first production token generated OR 30 days after PO receipt (whichever is earlier).
- If procurement requires billing to start only after PO is received, we can accommodate but need a signed PO and a guaranteed 6-month minimum to maintain the proposed discounts.
- Net60 requests: we can offer Net60 for enterprise contracts with an additional 1.0% fee or a modest rebate adjustment.

Can you loop in Raj from procurement (I believe you mentioned him) and confirm the PO cadence and payment-term preference? If Raj is ok, I’ll have Legal draft an amendment with explicit invoicing language and a DocuSign for signatures.

Next steps I propose:
- Today: confirm procurement contact + PO timing
- Wed 5/19: I send updated MAP + SOW with invoice language
- Week of 5/24: target signature and PO issuance so we can begin pilot week of 5/31

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20-min call if useful.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Emma / Raj —

Appreciate the rapid reply and for bringing procurement in. Answers to your two asks and an operational proposal below.

1) Earliest billing start if PO issued on May 25:
   - If your PO explicitly states "billing start upon PO receipt," we will start invoicing on receipt of PO; that means first invoice would be dated as soon as systems process the PO (typically within 3 business days) and the invoice payment term will follow Net60 if we accept it.
   - If you prefer billing to start on go-live, we can anchor billing start to the first production token, but this requires a signed PO before go-live.

2) Discounts / committed volumes:
   - Pilot (30 days): 15% discount if Finnovate commits to pilot capacity of X tokens/month and provides usage forecasts.
   - Ramp through month 3: 10% discount on committed baseline if you commit to a 3-month runway post-PO.
   - Enterprise tiered pricing beyond month 3 based on committed monthly tokens; larger commitments reduce per-token price.

Operational compromise to accommodate Net60 request:
- We can accept Net60 on enterprise contracts provided Finnovate either: (a) signs a 6-month minimum commitment OR (b) provides a PO plus an approved credit application (our finance team will run a quick check). There is a small commercial trade-off: Net60 + no minimum = a 1.0% surcharge or removal of the pilot discount. If Finnovate signs the 6-month minimum, we will honor the pilot discount and the tiered pricing.

I attached an updated MAP (Finnovate_MAP_v2.xlsx) and a pricing breakdown (pricing_breakdown_20270519.xlsx) that map the exact discount & invoice triggers.

Proposed short timeline:
- 5/19: review MAP & SOW (attached)
- 5/21: Redwood legal finalizes invoice/PO language (we aim to accommodate Net60 if a 6-month commit is accepted)
- 5/25: Finnovate issues PO / sign DocuSign
- 5/31: pilot begins (assuming PO signed)

If that sounds workable I’ll have Legal prepare the DocuSign and SOW. Marissa — can you confirm CS support availability for the pilot week of 5/31?

Best,
Alex

Attachments: Finnovate_MAP_v2.xlsx, pricing_breakdown_20270519.xlsx

Alex / Marissa / Marcus —

I reviewed the proposed invoicing triggers and payment-term options. Draft notes for the SOW and commercial terms:

- Billing start: include both options in the SOW: (i) "Billing commences upon issuance of PO and receipt of signed SOW" OR (ii) "Billing commences upon first production token generation, provided a PO is submitted within 30 days of go-live." This preserves flexibility for both sides.
- Net terms: Accept Net60 only if customer signs a minimum 6-month revenue commitment OR completes our standard credit application. If customer wants Net60 without a term commitment, add a 1.0% administrative fee to the invoice.
- PO requirements: Require PO number on all invoices; include standard remittance instructions and Redwood tax ID. Specify contact for invoice disputes and a 30-day dispute resolution window.
- Discounts: Pilot discount must be explicitly tied to volume commitments in the MAP spreadsheet; include a clause that discounts are contingent on timely PO issuance (to avoid retroactive discount demands).

I attached the SOW redline (Finnovate_SOW_v1.pdf) and a short clause text that we can copy into DocuSign. If Alex approves the redline I’ll upload the DocuSign powerform link and legal will run the DocuSign envelope. Marcus — can you confirm Finance is OK with the proposed Net60 with credit-app workflow?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
